captures.description: THE NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Data portraits are visual representations of people made by plotting their accumulated data rather than drawing or photographing their physical faces.' Key examples and meanings: W. E. B. Du Bois's visualizations (1900); personal and digital data portraits (Judith Donath); live interactive art (Giorgia Lupi, TED 2017); 'AI & Machine Learning Artifacts: Contemporary research groups use the term for lightweight inspection tools (like Data Portraits) that record dataset training traces.' An offer of the three directions. Eight cards: giorgialupi, Data Portraits, Zinn Education Project, Pentagram, SparkMap, a YouTube talk (University of Massachusetts Amherst Libraries), MIT Media Lab, ARTnews.com.
